_comment: Single source of truth for the active measurement regime. run_pass.ps1 reads this (model, split, threads, cache, env, draft args, floors) and -Model/-Split/-Threads/-MaxLength/-Env/-Extra carry only the DELTA under test. When the model or a winner changes, change it here once; plans express steps as deltas against this file so a swap cannot leave stale hardcoded commands behind.

notes: split 376 is the measured 3.18 boundary: 368 loads but dies in long prefill (allocator scratch), 376 measured fastest
cache_size 131072 is the measurement length; 262144 is a single final confirmation
spec_decode runs use draft.spec_decode_cache_size (a 1024-token generation needs 139 pages = 35584 tokens)
frozen_state_dir is used as XDG_CACHE_HOME so expert/token profiles are identical for every arm
run_pass copies frozen_state_master -> frozen_state_dir before every run and points XDG_CACHE_HOME there, so no arm inherits another arm's expert/token profile

history.change: production model 3.68bpw_h6_ng8 -> 3.18bpw_h6_ng8 (operator: no headroom, 8 GB lighter); split re-founded 400 -> 376
history.carried_results: MEMOPS=0 (engine path, not per checkpoint); thresholds re-derived on 3.18 (pp 0.92-0.99, tg 0.91-1.01)
